questionAudits.original: The editor is certain that the missing pages were removed deliberately.
questionAudits.target: The editor is convinced that the missing pages ____.
completedSentences: The editor is convinced that the missing pages must have been removed deliberately.
questionAudits.rationale: must have been加过去分词表示对过去被动事件的确信推断，保留编辑认为缺页遭故意移除的判断。must后不能用had。

questionAudits.original: We did not consider the cost of colour printing.
questionAudits.target: We failed ____ the cost of colour printing.
completedSentences: We failed to take into account the cost of colour printing.
questionAudits.rationale: take into account表示考虑某项成本，failed to保留没有考虑的事实。固定短语为into account，不能用in account。

questionAudits.original: I wish I had kept a copy of the original cover design.
questionAudits.target: I regret ____ of the original cover design.
completedSentences: I regret not having kept a copy of the original cover design.
I regret not keeping a copy of the original cover design.
questionAudits.rationale: regret not having kept或not keeping均可表达对过去未保留副本的遗憾。保留否定NOT；have keeping不能构成完成动名词。

questionAudits.original: It was unnecessary for the designer to pay for another copy, but she did.
questionAudits.target: The designer ____ another copy.
completedSentences: The designer need not have paid for another copy.
questionAudits.rationale: need not have done表示过去实际做了但并无必要，正对应已付款而不必要。need后不能用had构成该情态完成结构。

questionAudits.original: The publisher has decided that it will not accept any more late changes.
questionAudits.target: The publisher has decided ____ any more late changes.
completedSentences: The publisher has decided not to put up with any more late changes.
questionAudits.rationale: put up with在此表示容忍或接受；not to保留出版方已经作出的不再接受迟来修改的决定。put up for不是该含义的搭配。

questionAudits.original: As far as I know, the index has not yet been checked.
questionAudits.target: To ____, the index has not yet been checked.
completedSentences: To the best of my knowledge, the index has not yet been checked.
questionAudits.rationale: to the best of my knowledge表示就我所知，与as far as I know保留相同知识范围限定。of是固定介词，不能替换成from。

questionAudits.original: The storm was the only reason the night ferry did not leave.
questionAudits.target: If ____ the storm, the night ferry would have left.
completedSentences: If it had not been for the storm, the night ferry would have left.
questionAudits.rationale: If it had not been for表示过去若非某一阻碍，本来就会离港，与风暴是唯一原因对应。with不能替换该反事实条件搭配中的for。

questionAudits.original: Passengers must never step onto the ramp before the crew open the gate.
questionAudits.target: On ____ the ramp before the crew open the gate.
accepted: no account must passengers step onto
completedSentences: On no account must passengers step onto the ramp before the crew open the gate.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: no account passengers must step onto
questionAudits.rationale: On no account前置表示绝不允许，必须使用must passengers step的部分倒装。保留乘客和登船坡道、开门前这一限制。

questionAudits.original: The extra inspection delayed our departure by two hours.
questionAudits.target: Our departure ____ two hours by the extra inspection.
completedSentences: Our departure was put back by two hours by the extra inspection.
Our departure was put back two hours by the extra inspection.
Our departure was put back for two hours by the extra inspection.
questionAudits.rationale: put back表示推迟；标明两小时延迟时可用by、for或直接接时长。put的过去分词仍为put；putted只适用于高尔夫等其他词义，不适用于推迟出发。

questionAudits.original: Boarding will begin only when the last truck has been secured.
questionAudits.target: Not ____ has been secured will boarding begin.
completedSentences: Not until the last truck has been secured will boarding begin.
questionAudits.rationale: Not until引导的时间条件前置，主句倒装为will boarding begin；空内保留the last truck的正确词序和确定指代。

questionAudits.original: The crossing was much less smooth than had been advertised.
questionAudits.target: The crossing was ____ had been advertised.
accepted: not anywhere near as smooth as
completedSentences: The crossing was nowhere near as smooth as had been advertised.
The crossing was not anywhere near as smooth as had been advertised.
The crossing was nowhere near so smooth as had been advertised.
questionAudits.rationale: nowhere near as或so...as表示实际平稳程度远低于宣传，保留比较方向。该结构必须以as衔接后文，不能接than。

questionAudits.original: The late arrival did not surprise the regular passengers at all.
questionAudits.target: The late arrival came ____ the regular passengers.
completedSentences: The late arrival came as no surprise to the regular passengers.
questionAudits.rationale: come as no surprise to somebody表示某人完全不感意外，保留熟客对晚到的反应。of不能在该结构中引出感受者。

questionAudits.original: The photographer insisted that the client credit the assistants.
questionAudits.target: The photographer ____ by the client.
accepted: insisted on the assistants being credited
insisted upon the assistants being credited
completedSentences: The photographer insisted on the assistants being credited by the client.
The photographer insisted upon the assistants being credited by the client.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: insisted for the assistants being credited
questionAudits.rationale: insist on或upon加被动动名词，保留摄影师要求客户给助理署名的施事关系；by the client不能遗漏。for不接这一要求结构。

questionAudits.original: I found it impossible to distinguish the twin negatives.
questionAudits.target: I could ____ the twin negatives.
completedSentences: I could not tell the difference between the twin negatives.
questionAudits.rationale: tell the difference between表示区分两个对象，could not保留无法分辨这两张底片的含义。这里不能用of代替between。

questionAudits.original: The studio blamed the assistant for the flash failure because he had forgotten to charge the battery.
questionAudits.target: The flash failure ____ the assistant by the studio, because he had forgotten to charge the battery.
completedSentences: The flash failure was blamed on the assistant by the studio, because he had forgotten to charge the battery.
questionAudits.rationale: blame somebody for something被动改为something was blamed on somebody；保留by the studio这一实际归责者，不能从客观原因擅自推断有人归责。

questionAudits.original: The insurance policy did not include damage caused by salt water.
questionAudits.target: Damage caused by salt water ____ the insurance policy.
completedSentences: Damage caused by salt water was not covered by the insurance policy.
Damage caused by salt water wasn't covered by the insurance policy.
questionAudits.rationale: be covered by a policy表示属于保险保障范围，否定形式保留盐水损害不在范围内。from不能引出提供保障的保单。

questionAudits.original: The freelancer accepted the commission only because she was allowed to choose the location.
questionAudits.target: The freelancer's acceptance of the commission ____ choose the location.
accepted: was dependent on being allowed to
was dependent upon being allowed to
completedSentences: The freelancer's acceptance of the commission was dependent on being allowed to choose the location.
The freelancer's acceptance of the commission was dependent upon being allowed to choose the location.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: was dependent for being allowed to
questionAudits.rationale: be dependent on或upon表示依赖某一条件，being allowed to保留获准选择拍摄地点这一必要条件。for不是dependent在此的搭配。

questionAudits.original: I must ensure that none of the client's images remain on this computer.
questionAudits.target: I must ____ the client's images remain on this computer.
completedSentences: I must make sure that none of the client's images remain on this computer.
I must make sure none of the client's images remain on this computer.
questionAudits.rationale: make sure that none of或省略that，都保留客户所有图像一个也不能留下的要求。none后用of引出该图像集合，不能用from。

questionAudits.original: It took the volunteers a full morning to move the carriage.
questionAudits.target: The volunteers ____ the carriage.
completedSentences: The volunteers spent a full morning moving the carriage.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: spent a full morning to move
questionAudits.rationale: spend a period doing表达把整上午用于移动车厢，对应it took结构。spend后活动用动名词moving，不能直接以to move作该补语。

questionAudits.original: The museum acquired the engine only after lengthy negotiations.
questionAudits.target: Only after lengthy negotiations ____ the engine.
completedSentences: Only after lengthy negotiations did the museum acquire the engine.
questionAudits.rationale: Only after时间状语前置时主句部分倒装，did后必须用acquire原形。收购发生在漫长谈判之后这一时间顺序保持不变。

questionAudits.original: You are not allowed to enter the cab without a member of staff.
questionAudits.target: You ____ the cab without a member of staff.
accepted: do not have permission to enter
completedSentences: You do not have permission to enter the cab without a member of staff.
You have no permission to enter the cab without a member of staff.
You don't have permission to enter the cab without a member of staff.
questionAudits.rationale: have permission to do表示获准进入，否定保留没有工作人员陪同时不得进入的规则。permission后不能直接用entering作该补语。

questionAudits.original: I had expected the signal box to be much larger.
questionAudits.target: The signal box was ____ I had expected.
accepted: not anywhere near as large as
completedSentences: The signal box was nowhere near as large as I had expected.
The signal box was not anywhere near as large as I had expected.
The signal box was nowhere near so large as I had expected.
questionAudits.rationale: nowhere near...as说明实际大小远不及我先前预期，保留实际较小这一比较方向。than不能与as或so large形成此结构。

questionAudits.original: They failed to consider how the crane would enter the yard.
questionAudits.target: They ____ how the crane would enter the yard.
completedSentences: They failed to take into account how the crane would enter the yard.
questionAudits.rationale: fail to take into account与fail to consider均表示未把吊车进场方式纳入考虑，保留原句失败事实。固定搭配为into account。

questionAudits.original: We were just about to open the doors when the fire alarm rang.
questionAudits.target: We ____ opening the doors when the fire alarm rang.
completedSentences: We were on the point of opening the doors when the fire alarm rang.
questionAudits.rationale: be on the point of doing表示正要做某事，与警报响起前即将开门对应。of后接动名词opening，不能换成to。

questionAudits.original: We could not continue the course unless we had properly sharpened tools.
questionAudits.target: Continuing the course depended ____.
completedSentences: Continuing the course depended on having properly sharpened tools.
Continuing the course depended upon having properly sharpened tools.
questionAudits.rationale: depend on或upon加动名词短语表示继续课程取决于拥有磨好的工具，保留unless表达的必要条件。depend of不是该搭配。

questionAudits.original: The tutor let us use the workshop after class.
questionAudits.target: The tutor ____ the workshop after class.
completedSentences: The tutor gave us permission to use the workshop after class.
questionAudits.rationale: give somebody permission to do表示准许我们课后使用工作室，与let us use相同。for use不能替代这里带明确施事者的to use补语。

questionAudits.original: I regretted the fact that I had used that splintered piece of wood.
questionAudits.target: I regretted ____ piece of wood.
completedSentences: I regretted having used that splintered piece of wood.
questionAudits.rationale: regret having used保留对先前使用这块有木刺材料的遗憾。used后直接接该材料，额外的to不能放在that splintered piece前。

questionAudits.original: The repair cost twice as much as the tutor had estimated.
questionAudits.target: The repair was ____ the tutor had estimated.
completedSentences: The repair was twice as expensive as the tutor had estimated.
questionAudits.rationale: twice as expensive as与cost twice as much as保留价格为估算两倍的关系。more不能与这里的as结尾混成比较结构。

questionAudits.original: The apprentice's careless sanding caused the veneer to come off.
questionAudits.target: The veneer came off ____ the apprentice's careless sanding.
completedSentences: The veneer came off as a result of the apprentice's careless sanding.
questionAudits.rationale: as a result of引出原因，保留粗心打磨导致饰面脱落的因果方向。of不能在这里换成to。

questionAudits.original: The instructions say that we must always unplug the sander before changing its belt.
questionAudits.target: According to the instructions, we ____ before changing its belt.
accepted: must unplug the sander without fail
completedSentences: According to the instructions, we must unplug the sander without fail before changing its belt.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: must unplug the sander with fail
questionAudits.rationale: without fail对应必须每次切断砂光机电源，保留说明书中的强制要求与操作先后。with fail不是务必完成的英语搭配。

questionAudits.original: I did not start to understand the story until Ana had drawn a map.
questionAudits.target: Only when Ana had drawn a map ____ understand the story.
completedSentences: Only when Ana had drawn a map did I start to understand the story.
Only when Ana had drawn a map did I begin to understand the story.
questionAudits.rationale: Only when前置引发主句倒装，did I start或begin to保留到画好地图后才开始理解的先后关系。did后不用started。

questionAudits.original: He is quite accustomed to hearing different accents now.
questionAudits.target: He ____ different accents now.
completedSentences: He is quite used to hearing different accents now.
questionAudits.rationale: be used to doing表示已经习惯，与be accustomed to hearing对应。to在此为介词，必须接hearing，不是表示过去习惯的used to hear。

questionAudits.original: I could not avoid smiling when I heard the joke.
questionAudits.target: I ____ when I heard the joke.
completedSentences: I could not help smiling when I heard the joke.
I couldn't help smiling when I heard the joke.
questionAudits.rationale: cannot或could not help doing表示忍不住，保留听笑话后无法避免微笑的过去反应。help to smile在这里会改变为帮助微笑的结构。

questionAudits.original: I was mistaken to think that these words had the same meaning.
questionAudits.target: I ____ these words had the same meaning.
completedSentences: I was wrong to think that these words had the same meaning.
I was wrong in thinking that these words had the same meaning.
questionAudits.rationale: be wrong to think或in thinking均表达认为词义相同是错误判断，保留过去时和判断内容。for think不能构成该补语。

questionAudits.original: We should keep the conversation in English as much as possible.
questionAudits.target: We should speak English ____.
completedSentences: We should speak English as far as possible.
questionAudits.rationale: as far as possible在此表示尽可能使用英语，保留原句尽量保持英语交流的要求。possibly不能代替固定表达末尾的形容词possible。

questionAudits.original: You need not apologise for asking me to repeat the directions.
questionAudits.target: There is ____ for asking me to repeat the directions.
accepted: no need for you to apologise
no need for you to apologize
completedSentences: There is no need for you to apologise for asking me to repeat the directions.
There is no need to apologise for asking me to repeat the directions.
There is no need for you to apologize for asking me to repeat the directions.
There is no need to apologize for asking me to repeat the directions.
questionAudits.rationale: there is no need to或no need for you to均表达不必为请人重复方向而道歉，英美apologise与apologize拼法均接纳。of you apologise不是该结构。

questionAudits.original: The lights went out just as we were beginning to analyse the samples.
questionAudits.target: We had ____ when the lights went out.
accepted: hardly started to analyse the samples
hardly begun to analyse the samples
completedSentences: We had hardly started analysing the samples when the lights went out.
We had hardly begun analysing the samples when the lights went out.
We had hardly started to analyse the samples when the lights went out.
We had hardly begun to analyse the samples when the lights went out.
We had hardly started analyzing the samples when the lights went out.
We had hardly begun analyzing the samples when the lights went out.
questionAudits.rationale: had hardly started或begun对应刚开始分析样品灯就灭了；动名词与不定式、英美analyse拼法的列出形式均保留相同事件。had后不用start原形。

questionAudits.original: The failure of the satellite clock forced us to abandon the measurements.
questionAudits.target: The failure of the satellite clock ____ abandon the measurements.
completedSentences: The failure of the satellite clock obliged us to abandon the measurements.
questionAudits.rationale: oblige somebody to do表示迫使我们放弃测量，与forced us to相同，保留故障造成的因果方向。for不能引出这里的不定式。

questionAudits.original: Without a spare battery, the logger would have stopped before dawn.
questionAudits.target: The logger would have stopped before dawn ____.
completedSentences: The logger would have stopped before dawn but for a spare battery.
questionAudits.rationale: but for加名词短语可表示若不是有备用电池，与过去反事实条件without对应。from不能替换该固定条件表达中的for。

questionAudits.original: The instrument will work properly if it is kept level.
questionAudits.target: The instrument will work properly ____ level.
completedSentences: The instrument will work properly provided it is kept level.
The instrument will work properly provided that it is kept level.
questionAudits.rationale: provided或provided that引出与if相同的条件：仪器保持水平即可正常工作。被动结构词序为it is kept，不能写it kept is。

questionAudits.original: Some tracks were damaged, but the team continued collecting data.
questionAudits.target: The team continued collecting data ____ some damaged tracks.
completedSentences: The team continued collecting data despite there being some damaged tracks.
questionAudits.rationale: despite后接there being动名词结构，保留部分道路损坏仍继续采集数据的让步关系。despite不能直接引出there were有限从句。

questionAudits.original: The new sensor was much more reliable than its predecessor.
questionAudits.target: The old sensor was ____ the new one.
accepted: not anywhere near as reliable as
completedSentences: The old sensor was nowhere near as reliable as the new one.
The old sensor was not anywhere near as reliable as the new one.
The old sensor was nowhere near so reliable as the new one.
questionAudits.rationale: 把新传感器更可靠改写为旧传感器远不如新传感器可靠，比较方向不变。nowhere near as或so...as结尾不能用than。
